name: Blend
description: Lending/borrowing protocol on Stellar testnet (Tranche 2 integration fixture)

functions.name: supply
functions.description: Supply an asset to the Blend pool and receive b-tokens representing the deposit

functions.name: withdraw
functions.description: Withdraw a previously supplied asset by burning the corresponding b-tokens

functions.name: borrow
functions.description: Borrow an asset against deposited collateral

functions.name: repay
functions.description: Repay a previously borrowed amount and reduce the debt position

functions.name: liquidate
functions.description: Liquidate an undercollateralised borrower position and claim the collateral discount

functions.name: get_position
functions.description: Return the current supply and borrow balance for a user

functions.name: stake
functions.description: Stake tokens into the Blend backstop or staking module

functions.name: unstake
functions.description: Unstake tokens previously staked in the Blend backstop or staking module
